airQuality.label: Gas level
airQuality.note: Grove Air Quality Sensor v1.3: analog and relative, NOT CO2. Devices publish aq = smoothed 10-bit reading minus the fresh-air baseline. 50 / 150 match Seeed's 'low pollution' / 'high pollution' levels; tune after testing. For a true CO2 sensor use label CO₂, unit ppm, good 800, poor 1200.
